findings.text: the push op description still states the retired invariant that a push demotes any other active sprint, false since 0ad5a171; the node done_when and plan section 4 assign reckon/mcp.py to another node, so this is a declared follow-on rather than a scope breach.
the multiple-active-sprints audit still reports error severity on a state this change makes legitimate; section 4 defers its retirement to the node that owns reckon/mcp.py.

the op-level clause of the change, the demotion warnings removed at reckon/project_state.py:2279, has no assertion: nothing in the file reaches apply_resource_ops for the push path, so a regression there would go uncaught.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base e731091f; 0ad5a171 removes the demote loop and its compensation arm from push_sprint (reckon/project_state.py 18+/61-), e8a67fc7 appends the landing record (28+/0-) and the execution record (95+/0-) plus one figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_sprint_push_status.py:74 (both stay active), :84 (stale version unchanged) and the declared mutation; the manifest records the gate at 11 passed, and I re-ran the file at the reviewed head (recheck-reviewed-head.log, 11 passed, module resolved to the reviewed worktree).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal names one method; reckon/project_state.py:1965 push_sprint now writes active on its target alone, leaving every other sprint's stored status untouched.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; it names commits 0ad5a171 and e8a67fc7, the gate and its three logs, the declared mutation with its red log, and the mcp-side residuals it leaves out of scope, all of which match the diff.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five paths and the two commits touch exactly those five (git diff --numstat e731091f..e8a67fc7), including the one added PNG under docs/figures/a-sprint-is-live-while-a-crew-works-it/.

justifications.durability: restoring the demote writes reddens tests/test_sprint_push_status.py:81 and restoring the returned demoted key reddens :80 in a scratch export of the head (mutation-M1.log, mutation-M2.log), while the op-level warnings removal at reckon/project_state.py:2279 has no test.
justifications.evidence: the gate logs are on disk and the file re-ran 11 passed at the reviewed head (recheck-reviewed-head.log), though the base arm is a repro script (repro-base.log) rather than the added test shown red at base.
justifications.fit: the docstring at reckon/project_state.py:1971 states the hint semantics in the module's own terms, no added name carries a plan or version label, and both commit subjects are conventional with a body.
justifications.goal_fidelity: push_sprint at reckon/project_state.py:1965 writes its target alone and returns just new_version (reckon/project_state.py:2013), which is the node's goal as dispatched.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat e731091f..e8a67fc7 touches exactly the five declared paths, with zero deletions in both cumulative docs files.
